blocks.label: 05 · The Collective
blocks.title: The Moodwalkrs.
intro: MOODWALKRS is a collective AI Creative Studio — quality driven.

We bring together producers, creative directors, directors, art directors, creative tech, AI & VFX experts, DOPs and editors to create, produce, and accelerate premium visuals — without sacrificing taste or intention.

founders.name: Stéphane “Corpus” Juffé
founders.bio: Award-winning Director / Producer / Creative Director with 20+ years across CGI, video and interactive content. Bridges agency-grade strategy with hands-on creative tech and digital entrepreneurship — the operating system of the studio.

founders.name: Thibaut Mitre
founders.bio: Director and producer working across brand content, music videos and fashion. Builds visual systems that travel from social to broadcast without losing density — equally at home with talent, brand teams and AI tooling.

founders.name: Aurélien Winterman
founders.bio: Producer with cinema-grade executive-production credits. Brings feature-film rigour to commercial and editorial work — schedules, crews, deliverables, finishing — so AI never compromises the production line.

founders.name: Fred de Pontcharra
founders.bio: Film director and photographer working across commercials, music videos and cinematic visual systems. His approach brings narrative rhythm, live-action grammar and premium image culture into AI-driven production.

blocks.closing: We build our own tools. We scale without losing soul. We create faster — with precision & quality.
